Our Associate Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Delivery will be an integral part of our global FDE team. This role is based remotely in Israel .
Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state, from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence™ , the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we specialize in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure , we work alongside thousands of customers worldwide.
The Team: Forward Deployed Engineering - Delivery
Our Delivery team helps existing customers understand their cloud usage and get value from DoiT Cloud Intelligence. You’ll work alongside customer success, account, and technical colleagues, learning from experienced engineers and helping customers make progress.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for a curious, proactive engineer who enjoys learning and helping customers solve problems. You’ll help customers understand their cloud usage and costs, learn DoiT Cloud Intelligence, and turn findings into clear next steps with our account and technical teams. You’ll ask questions, try things, learn from feedback, and follow through on agreed actions. This is an advisory role: customers make changes in their own environments.
Responsibilities
You’ll build your skills through focused customer work with support from senior engineers and the account team. This is an advisory role: customers implement changes in their own environments.
2-4 years of experience in helping troubleshoot customers’ cloud environments (AWS/Google Cloud/Azure) and responding to support requests with high-quality, well-explained resolutions. Investigating clearly scoped issues with experienced colleagues and escalating complex problems.
Help optimize customers’ cloud environments: work with experienced colleagues to assess compute, networking, storage, IAM, and observability; recommend improvements to cost efficiency, performance, reliability and resilience, and security posture; and reduce operational toil through automation. Guide the customer’s team through implementing agreed changes.
Learn DoiT Cloud Intelligence and help customers use its reports and insights.
Explain findings clearly, agree next steps with the team, and follow through on assigned actions. Escalate architecture recommendations and commitment decisions to senior engineers.
Document what you learn and share reusable solutions and customer feedback.
Contribute simple scripts or workflows that reduce repetitive work, with review and guidance.
Qualifications
Practical experience with one cloud platform (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) through work, projects, or hands-on labs, including compute, storage, networking, and access permissions (IAM).
At least one AWS / Google Cloud / Azure Professional Certification.
Basic troubleshooting skills: use logs or data to investigate a problem and explain what you tried and learned.
Ability to read and modify simple scripts in one language, such as Python or Bash.
Prior customer-facing experience.
Clear written and verbal communication and an interest in helping customers.
Curiosity and follow-through: ask questions, take initiative, try things, learn from feedback, and finish agreed work.
Bonus Points
Exposure to FinOps or cloud cost optimization.
Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
FinOps certifications.
Experience with working in a remote and/or global environment.
Experience with DoiT Cloud Intelligence.
